about: Hand-kept product choices of the EDGE Screener (report TARGET ARCHITECTURE 6.8, 6.9.1): per registry indicator the prototype shape, the test forms each output allows (with the prototype operators and labels), search synonyms, a one-line plain-English description (the catalog's tooltip and search text), the card a new condition opens with and, where a user decision narrows them, the offered options of an enum parameter with the value a card opens with (params; today P17 a for the I43 anchor); plus explicit overrides with evidence and the provisional cost model of the caps. Never a parameter range, unit, lag or input list: those come from backtest-registry.json or are derived by scripts/build-screener-registry.mjs.

cost_model.status: PROVISIONAL (P5): replaced by the Phase 17 measurement on the service, recorded in verification/screener/BENCHMARK.md with CPU and Node version
cost_model.rule: cap = floor(SCREENER_CAP_BUDGET_MS * 1e6 / (ns_per_bar_length * reference_bars)) for a parameter whose cost_class is O(N·n); none for O(N)
cost_model.evidence: audit/verify_matrix_a.json a-cost-long-length: CCI(1000) took 7.93 s on the full market (7.93e9 ns / (1.33e6 bars x 1000) = 5.96 ns); 1.33 M price rows, audit/reuse.md section 3.4 E

overrides.evidence: ERRORS M257; report 6.8: factor 0 passes the degeneracy probe (finite, varying output) yet gives 1,128 direction flips in 2,115 bars on BBRI against 60 at factor 3

I01.description: The plain average of the source price over the last N sessions, every session weighted the same.

I02.description: An average of the source price over N sessions that weights recent sessions more, so it turns sooner than the SMA.

I03.description: An average of the source price over N sessions with linearly rising weights: the newest session counts most.

I04.description: A moving average built from weighted averages over N and N/2 sessions, so it follows price closely with little lag.

I05.description: A moving average that speeds up while price trends cleanly and slows down while it moves sideways (efficiency over N sessions).

I06.description: The gap between a fast and a slow EMA of price, with a signal line (an EMA of the gap) and their difference as the histogram.

I07.description: Trend strength (ADX, 0 to 100) with the directional lines +DI and -DI that show whether up moves or down moves dominate.

I08.description: How recently the N-session high (Aroon Up) and the N-session low (Aroon Down) were set, scaled 0 to 100.

labels.crosses_above: Aroon Up crosses above Aroon Down
labels.crosses_below: Aroon Up crosses below Aroon Down

I09.description: A trailing line a multiple of the average true range below price in an uptrend or above it in a downtrend, with its direction.

I10.description: The highest high and the lowest low of the last N sessions, with their midpoint.

I11.description: A moving average with bands a multiple of the average true range (or of the bar range) above and below it.

I12.description: A stop-and-reverse level that trails price and accelerates as a trend extends; its direction flips when price crosses it.

I13.description: Average gains against average losses over N sessions, on a 0 to 100 scale.

I14.description: The stochastic oscillator applied to RSI: where RSI sits within its own N-session range, 0 to 100, with a smoothed signal.

I15.description: Where the close sits within the high-low range of the last N sessions, 0 to 100 (%K), with its moving average (%D).

I16.description: Where the close sits against the N-session range: 0 at the highest high, -100 at the lowest low.

I17.description: The percent change of the source price over N sessions.

I18.description: The change of the source price over N sessions, in price units.

I19.description: How far the typical price is from its N-session average, in units of its mean deviation.

I20.description: Up moves minus down moves over N sessions as a share of all moves, from -100 to 100.

I21.description: A double-smoothed ratio of price change to absolute price change, with a signal line.

I22.description: The one-session percent change of a triple-smoothed EMA of price.

I23.description: A weighted blend of buying pressure over a short, a middle and a long window, 0 to 100.

I24.description: A fast minus a slow simple average of the bar midpoint (high plus low, halved).

I25.description: The gap between a fast and a slow EMA of price in percent of the slow one, with a signal line and a histogram.

I26.description: Close minus open as a share of the bar's high-low range, from -1 to 1.

I27.description: A moving average with bands a multiple of the standard deviation of price above and below it.

I28.description: Where price sits between the lower Bollinger Band (0) and the upper one (1).

I29.description: The distance between the Bollinger Bands relative to their middle line; low values mark a squeeze.

I30.description: The average true range of the bars over N sessions, in price units.

I31.description: The average true range as a percent of the close.

I32.description: The standard deviation of the source price over N sessions, in price units.

I33.description: The annualized standard deviation of returns over N sessions, in percent.

I34.description: The average of high minus low over N sessions, in price units.

I35.description: The simple average of volume over N sessions.

I36.description: The exponential average of volume over N sessions.

I37.description: The session's volume divided by its average volume over N sessions.

I38.description: The gap between a fast and a slow EMA of volume in percent of the slow one, with a signal line and a histogram.

I39.description: The percent change of volume over N sessions.

I40.description: A running total that adds the session's volume when the close rises and subtracts it when the close falls.

disabled_tests.reason: The level of a cumulative line depends on where its history starts, so a threshold on it is not comparable across stocks (report 6.7).

I41.description: A running total of volume weighted by each session's percent price change.

disabled_tests.reason: The level of a cumulative line depends on where its history starts, so a threshold on it is not comparable across stocks (report 6.7).

I42.description: An average of the source price over N sessions weighted by each session's volume.

I43.description: The volume-weighted average price since the start of the chosen week, month, quarter or year, with optional bands.

probe.evidence: At the default anchor Session each daily bar is its own period, so upper1 and lower1 are one price plus or minus its own deviation (0 up to floating residue) and the scaling and lag probes would measure that residue; they run on a monthly anchor, where the bands are real. The unit and comparison of an output do not depend on the anchor.

anchor.decision: P17 (a), decided with the go of 2026-10-28 (EXEC.md EXEC-SCREENER: "Keputusan lain (P5-P7, P15-P19, P21-P23) mengikuti rekomendasi laporan"; report 13 P17, 6.9.1 vwap row): only the Week, Month, Quarter and Year anchors are offered. At Session each daily bar is its own period, so vwap = hlc3 within 2e-16 and a condition reduces to close vs typical price; Decade and Century span all stored history and behave like cumulative rows (report 04 footnote 19). start Week: the P17 consequence built as recommended (report 13 P17, 15 'to confirm'): the registry default Session is not offered, so the card opens as Custom at anchor Week and the snapshot pre-warms that configuration (report 6.7); the registry itself is unchanged (P6).

I44.description: A running total of volume weighted by where each close falls within its bar's range.

disabled_tests.reason: The level of a cumulative line depends on where its history starts, so a threshold on it is not comparable across stocks (report 6.7).

I45.description: The money-flow volume of the last N sessions divided by their total volume, from -1 to 1.

I46.description: A fast minus a slow EMA of the accumulation/distribution line.

I47.description: An RSI-like 0 to 100 oscillator of the typical price weighted by volume over N sessions.

I48.description: The price change times volume, smoothed by an EMA over N sessions.

I49.description: The move of the bar midpoint times the bar's range per unit of volume, averaged over N sessions.

I50.description: A running index that moves only on sessions when volume falls, by that session's percent price change.

disabled_tests.reason: The level of a cumulative line depends on where its history starts, so a threshold on it is not comparable across stocks (report 6.7).

I51.description: A running index that moves only on sessions when volume rises, by that session's percent price change.

disabled_tests.reason: The level of a cumulative line depends on where its history starts, so a threshold on it is not comparable across stocks (report 6.7).

I52.description: A fast minus a slow EMA of volume signed by the direction of the typical price, with a signal line.

I53.description: The bar's high-low range divided by its volume: how far price moved per unit traded.
